dedupe_keys.name: protected areas database of the united states pad us

description: PAD-US is the official national inventory of public land and other protected areas in the United States, including open space managed for recreation and cultural uses as well as for biodiversity. It is maintained by the U.S. Geological Survey Gap Analysis Project; version 4 was published on 25 April 2024 and revised on 31 March 2025, following earlier versions such as 1.4 and 2.0 (2018). The geodatabase describes areas with 36 attributes in feature classes for fee ownership parcels, designations, easements, marine areas, proclamations and other planning boundaries, plus a Combined layer; attributes include GAP Status Codes and a measure of public access for recreation. Coverage: all federal and most state and local lands, with voluntarily provided private and nonprofit protected areas. Access: national or state downloads as ArcGIS geodatabases from ScienceBase, and a WMS. Licence: public domain; free. Caveats: state and local coverage depends on data stewards, and some data carry over from earlier versions. Simulation uses: mapping public open space and parks for heat, flood and access studies, and siting public facilities. Related records: the World Database on Protected Areas and OS Open Greenspace.
